"They instantly connected over their shared passion for the arts and social justice," said a friend of the couple. "It was as if they had known each other for years." Eggerth, a legendary actress and singer who has appeared in numerous films and stage productions, including the iconic 1940s musical "For Me and My Gal," has been a fixture on the Hollywood scene for decades. Her marriage to Yusuf marks her third, following previous unions with actors Jan Kiepura and Zoltán Fábri. She and Abdul are enjoying every moment of their new life together."
